title: Domain consumer projection migration — binding-keyed bundles, coding-agent pilot
objective: Make every domain consumer binding declared in Quantum-L9/.github semantics/domain_consumer_bindings.yaml (v3.36.0, dcd9d00) materializable, verifiable, and replayable in Cursor-Governance through the existing projection-publication path, prove it end to end on l9.domain-consumer-binding/coding-agent@1, and activate a consumer only once its canonical unresolved coordinates, compiler binding composition, and post-merge trusted replay are closed. Consumers do not author binding semantics locally.
success_criteria: Binding-keyed driver mode produces generated/governance/domain_bindings/coding_agent/ with one per-domain bundle for each of the 6 required domains plus binding.lock.json pinning authority dcd9d00, compiler revision, binding ref, and every domain profile digest; proof V1
Fresh regeneration is byte-identical (--check) and the trusted-replay workflow covers the new bundle; proof V2

Verifier rejects a stale authority revision, a missing required domain, a conditional domain promoted to required, a digest mismatch, and a lock that claims cross-domain composition compiler 0.10.0 cannot produce; proof V3
Existing four profile-keyed bundles still pass --check unchanged and coding-agent-execution@1 remains the active coding-agent binding; proof V4
Activation status is reported per binding as BLOCKED with the exact canonical unresolved coordinate, never as active, until U1-U4 close; proof V5
Changed paths pass the repo hook catalog; proof V6
